title: FishBack: Pullback Fisher Geometry for Optimal Activation Steering in Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2605.17231v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Activation steering has emerged as a lightweight approach for modifying language model behavior without parameter updates, yet existing methods remain brittle: unstable across layers and prone to disturbing behavior unrelated to the target concept. We trace these failures to a hidden assumption shared by widely-used methods such as CAA, ActAdd, and ITI: that the intermediate activation space is Euclidean. We show this assumption is fundamentally flawed. The metric that actually governs how a hidden-state perturbation changes the output is the Fisher information metric of the softmax layer, pulled back to the intermediate layer through the Jacobian of the intervening layers. From it we derive a closed-form steering direction, applied to a hidden state at an intermediate layer, that reaches a target concept change with the least non-target distortion. translated_title: FishBack：基于拉回Fisher几何的最优变压器激活引导
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.17231v2 公告类型：替换交叉  摘要：激活引导已成为一种轻量级方法，用于在不更新参数的情况下修改语言模型行为，然而现有方法仍然脆弱：在不同层之间不稳定，且容易干扰与目标概念无关的行为。我们将这些失败追溯到广泛使用的方法（如CAA、ActAdd和ITI）共享的一个隐藏假设：中间激活空间是欧几里得的。我们证明这一假设存在根本性缺陷。真正控制隐藏状态扰动如何改变输出的度量是softmax层的Fisher信息度量，通过中间层的雅可比矩阵拉回到中间层。由此我们推导出一个闭式引导方向，应用于中间层的隐藏状态，以最小的非目标失真达到目标概念变化。该框架在早期和中期中间层最为有效，其中...（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出FishBack框架，通过拉回Fisher几何度量替代欧几里得假设，推导闭式引导方向，实现最小非目标失真的最优激活引导。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FishBack, which replaces the Euclidean assumption with pulled-back Fisher geometry to derive a closed-form steering direction for optimal activation steering with minimal non-target distortion.
